rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone receiving hospitality at a private home or other place.

example.english: I invited a guest to my home for dinner tonight.
example.traditional: 我今晚請咗個客人嚟屋企食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 ceng2 zo2 go3 haak3 jan4 lai4 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a guest staying in a hotel or other accommodation.

example.english: A guest at this hotel can park for free.
example.traditional: 呢間酒店嘅住客可以免費泊車。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 zyu6 haak3 ho2 ji5 min5 fai3 paak3 ce1

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the hotel guest as a customer or patron rather than as someone staying there.

example.english: The hotel must protect the rights of every guest.
example.traditional: 酒店必須保障每位顧客嘅權益。
example.jyutping: zau2 dim3 bit1 seoi1 bou2 zoeng3 mui5 wai2 gu3 haak3 ge3 kyun4 jik1

rows.note: Use this for a special or invited guest at an institution, event, or broadcast.

example.english: The show has invited a famous guest tonight.
example.traditional: 今晚個節目請咗一位著名嘉賓。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 go3 zit3 muk6 ceng2 zo2 jat1 wai2 zoek3 ming4 gaa1 ban1
